Actor Randolph Mantooth, known for 'Emergency!', dies at 80

Randolph Mantooth, an actor recognized for his role in the television series 'Emergency!', has passed away at the age of 80. The show, which aired in the 1970s, is noted for its portrayal of paramedics and their work.
